text: Vivid magenta gravlax cured with grated beets and dill, presented on snappy caraway rye crisps over a smear of horseradish crème fraîche. It is an exquisitely colorful and savory Scandinavian delight.
name: Beetroot Cured Salmon on Rye Crisps

text: Individual butter crusts filled with silky custard infused with cinnamon, cardamom, and black tea, topped with spiced pear slices under a glassy torched sugar lid. The gentle cracking sound leads to pure spiced bliss.
name: Chai-Spiced Pear Crème Brûlée Tartlets

text: Petite French almond and browned-butter cakes crowned with a caramelized fresh apricot slice and fragrant sprig of rosemary. Tender, nutty, and perfumed with herbal sunshine, they offer a sophisticated sweetness.
name: Apricot Rosemary Financiers

text: Crisp baguette rounds topped with warm goat cheese rolled in spiced crushed pecans and drizzled with hot pepper honey. The contrast of tangy cream and spicy-sweet crunch makes for an irresistible snack.
name: Pecan Crusted Goat Cheese Crostini

text: Jewel-toned gourmet fruit jellies bursting with tropical guava nectar and tart passion fruit pulp, dusted with shimmering superfine sugar. Each tender square yields a vibrant, intensely sweet-tart chew.
name: Guava and Passion Fruit Pâte de Fruit

text: Airy, golden cheese puffs made from choux pastry baked with sharp asiago, filled with a warm and creamy roasted artichoke purée. Light as air, yet brimming with savory richness in every bite.
name: Artichoke and Asiago Stuffed Gougères

text: Elegant layered dessert cups featuring silky coconut panna cotta, fresh mango compote, and a bright zest of lime. Finished with toasted coconut flakes, it offers a refreshing and luxurious sweet escape.
name: Coconut Lime Mango Verrines

text: Flaky golden phyllo pastry is rolled with crushed emerald pistachios and infused with fragrant green cardamom syrup. A delicate drizzle of orange blossom glaze completes this delightfully crisp, sweet confection.
name: Cardamom Pistachio Baklava Rolls

text: A refreshing blend of ripe heirloom tomatoes, sweet peppers, and cucumber provides a zesty, cooling soup. Each shot is crowned with a tender medallion of butter-poached lobster for an elegant savory treat.
name: Chilled Gazpacho Shooters with Poached Lobster

text: Dainty Parisian almond meringue shells are delicately infused with aromatic French lavender blossoms. Filled with a rich, silky Earl Grey tea white chocolate ganache, they melt into a perfumed sweet indulgence.
name: Earl Grey Lavender Macarons

text: Slow-cooked, shredded duck is gently spiced and spread over toasted, buttery brioche squares. A dollop of tart spiced cranberry relish cuts through the rich, savory meat perfectly.
name: Duck Confit and Cranberry Rillettes on Brioche

text: Buttery, flaky miniature buttermilk biscuits are generously studded with sharp smoked cheddar cheese and tangy pickled jalapeños. Brushed with herb butter right out of the oven, they pack comforting savory warmth.
name: Smoked Cheddar and Pickled Jalapeño Biscuits

text: Decadent vanilla bean shortbread cookies embrace a scoop of roasted strawberry gelato laced with aged balsamic reduction. Every bite harmonizes bright fruit sweetness with a subtle, rich tang.
name: Roasted Strawberry Balsamic Gelato Sandwiches

text: Bright green, silky sweet pea and mint purée is generously spread over char-grilled country bread. Finished with shavings of aged pecorino and an earthy drizzle of white truffle oil, this is a decadent savory starter.
name: Truffled Sweet Pea Puree Bruschetta

text: Tender sponge cakes are warmly spiced with ground turmeric, fresh ginger, and cinnamon before being soaked in clover honey syrup. A crown of whipped mascarpone gives these sweet bites a smooth, cloud-like texture.
name: Golden Turmeric and Ginger Honey Cakes

text: Juicy, caramelized pork meatballs are tossed in a tingly chili oil reduction with crushed Szechuan peppercorns. Garnished with finely sliced scallions, they deliver a punchy kick of bold savory flavor.
name: Szechuan Pepper Pork Meatballs

text: Flaky puff pastry tartlet shells are layered with creamy, tangy whipped feta cheese and fresh oregano. Ruby-red pomegranate arils burst on the palate, adding a juicy contrast to the rich, savory base.
name: Whipped Feta and Pomegranate Tartlets

text: Spicy artisanal North African lamb merguez sausage is folded with sweet roasted peppers inside buttery, flaky golden pastry. Served with a cool mint yogurt dip, these savory bites are immensely satisfying.
name: Lamb Merguez and Roasted Red Pepper Pasties

text: Layers of delicate, caramelized puff pastry are stacked high with rich pastry cream infused with smoked vanilla beans. Dustings of confectioners' sugar provide an elegant touch to this sophisticated sweet classic.
name: Smoked Vanilla Bean Mille-Feuille

text: Tender grilled octopus sits atop a crisp corn tortilla, finished with creamy avocado puree and a bright squeeze of lime. Each bite delivers a harmonious mix of smoky depth and refreshing coastal crunch.
name: Charred Octopus Tostadas

text: Crisp-tender asparagus spears are tightly bundled in savory prosciutto and blistered over open flames. A drizzle of aged balsamic reduction ties the smoky, salty flavors together beautifully.
name: Prosciutto Wrapped Grilled Asparagus

text: Sweet Medjool dates are stuffed with spicy Spanish chorizo and sharp manchego cheese before being baked until bubbling. The balance of heat, salt, and natural fruit sweetness creates a truly addictive bite.
name: Chorizo and Manchego Stuffed Dates

text: Decadent dark chocolate custard infused with rich espresso is chilled to velvety perfection. A sprinkling of flaky sea salt elevates the deep, roasted cocoa notes.
name: Salted Espresso Pot de Creme

text: Glazed with sweet soy and star anise, tender pork belly chunks rest in cool, crisp butter lettuce leaves. Quick-pickled daikon and fresh scallions provide a vibrant, crunchy contrast.
name: Crispy Pork Belly Lettuce Cups

text: Traditional slow-simmered Indian ice cream is scented with fragrant floral rosewater and crushed pistachios. Creamy and dense, these frozen treats offer an exotic and refreshing finish.
name: Pistachio Rosewater Kulfi Pops

text: Silky marinated white anchovies and briny Castelvetrano olives are skewered together with pickled piparra peppers. A drizzle of extra virgin olive oil highlights the clean, bright Mediterranean flavors.
name: Wild Boquerones and Olive Pinchos

text: Chewy, pillowy rice dough is dusted with toasted sesame seeds and filled with a nutty black sesame cream. The rich, earthy sweetness leaves a lasting impression on the palate.
name: Black Sesame Cream Mochi

text: Bite-sized buckwheat pancakes are topped with velvety crème fraîche, delicate folds of oak-smoked salmon, and a pop of briny caviar. Fresh chives add an herbaceous snap to this luxurious classic.
name: Smoked Salmon Blinis with Caviar

text: Caramelized brown sugar peaches are threaded onto skewers alongside cubes of buttery biscuit dough and grilled until golden. A warm bourbon glaze coats every piece with sweet, oaky warmth.
name: Bourbon Peach Cobbler Skewers

text: Rich, slow-braised oxtail is cooked down with sweet shallots into a savory spread served on toasted brioche. Microgreens and pickled mustard seeds cut through the profound decadence.
name: Oxtail Marmalade Brioche Toasts

text: Moist mini cakes infused with fragrant Meyer lemon zest and fruity extra virgin olive oil offer a tender crumb. A thin citrus glaze adds a delightful crackle to each sunny bite.
name: Meyer Lemon Olive Oil Cakes

text: Tender artichoke quarters are rolled in nutty aged parmesan and golden breadcrumbs before being baked crisp. They pair deliciously with a garlic and fresh herb aioli.
name: Parmesan Crusted Artichoke Hearts

text: Individual crisp meringue shells reveal a marshmallowy center piled high with vanilla cream and syrup-soaked kumquats. The citrusy tang offsets the airy sweetness with vibrant flair.
name: Candied Kumquat Pavlova Clouds

text: Crisp water chestnuts are enveloped in smoky thick-cut bacon and baked in a tangy brown sugar glaze. The delightful crunch combined with sweet and salty juices makes them an instant crowd-pleaser.
name: Bacon Wrapped Water Chestnuts

text: Pillowy fried dough parcels are filled with a luscious roasted pecan praline cream. Liberally dusted with powdered sugar, they melt into a warm, nutty indulgence.
name: Praline Stuffed Beignets

text: Slow-cooked spiced beef and melty Oaxaca cheese are griddled inside mini tortillas until delightfully crunchy. Served with a deeply savory consommé cup for dipping.
name: Birria Quesadilla Crisps

text: Sweet balsamic-roasted strawberries are churned with fresh garden basil into a refreshing, silky gelato. The herbaceous undertone makes the berry flavors sing with sophistication.
name: Roasted Strawberry Basil Gelato

text: Steamed young soybeans in the pod are tossed in a fiery, aromatic blend of toasted garlic, sesame oil, and red chili flakes. The spicy glaze demands to be licked off your fingers with every pod.
name: Chili Garlic Edamame Pots

text: Mini swirls of enriched brioche dough are woven with dark brown sugar, cinnamon, and toasted buttered pecans. Baked until gooey and glazed with vanilla syrup, they offer bakery-fresh warmth.
name: Cinnamon Pecan Babka Bites

text: Rich Stilton blue cheese and toasted English walnuts are baked inside buttery, golden puff pastry squares. A brush of wildflower honey balances the assertive, creamy bite of the cheese.
name: Stilton and Walnut Puff Pastries

text: Soft biscuit rounds are layered with tart passion fruit jelly and pillowy mallow, completely enrobed in dark chocolate. Biting into the chocolate shell reveals an explosion of tropical brightness.
name: Passion Fruit Marshmallow Teacakes

text: Mini crusty sourdough slices are crowned with rich whipped bone marrow and roasted sweet garlic cloves. Flaky sea salt and chopped Italian parsley balance the unctuous, savory profile.
name: Roasted Bone Marrow Garlic Toasties

text: Delicate almond shortbread cookies are studded with salted, preserved cherry blossom petals for a stunning floral finish. Their subtle nutty base highlights the gentle, sweet blossom perfume.
name: Cherry Blossom Almond Cookies

text: Crispy beer-battered cauliflower florets are tossed in a sharp, buttery hot sauce. Served with a cool gorgonzola dip, they offer a punchy vegetarian kick of savory heat.
name: Buffalo Cauliflower Florets

text: Layers of paper-thin caramelized puff pastry are stacked high with rich dulce de leche and whipped mascarpone cream. Every forkful yields a sublime symphony of crisp texture and sweet dairy depth.
name: Dulce de Leche Mille-Feuille Bites
